assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations.
The patient has episodes of dizziness.
The palpitations and dizziness are concerning for underlying arrhythmia.
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
A cardiac event monitoring study is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances and for further evaluation.
The service addresses the clinical need to link reported symptoms of palpitations and dizziness to potential cardiac rhythm issues.
